title: Figure 1. York Extrinsic Time (θ) Plot of Alcubierre warp drive bubble
description: Wireframe 3D surface plot showing the York extrinsic time θ for a warp bubble, with a positive peak on one side and a negative trough on the other, plotted against x and (y²+z²)^1/2 axes. Caption reads "Figure 1. York Extrinsic Time (θ) Plot". It accompanies section "2. General Relativistic Warp Drives", which presents the Alcubierre metric equations (2.1) and (2.2).
